extensionName.message: Danmaku Flow for YouTube: Live Chat Overlay

extensionDescription.message: Overlay YouTube live chat as customizable danmaku and floating comments.

sectionGeneralHint.message: These settings are not affected by Display Mode.

fontSizeHint.message: Larger values make text larger and allow fewer comments at once.

maxWidthHint.message: Text over this width is truncated with …; set to 0 for no limit.

opacityHint.message: 0% is fully transparent and 100% is fully opaque.

backgroundOpacityHint.message: Also applies to the original background color of paid comments.

outlineRatioHint.message: The outline scales proportionally with text size.

extendedStyleHint.message: Applied to all danmaku text; recommended only for people familiar with CSS.

flexibleFontSizeHint.message: Text resizes automatically with the player height.

fixedFontSizeHint.message: Text size does not change with player size.

displayTimeHint.message: Time for a comment to move from the right to the left of the player.

delayTimeHint.message: Comments begin after this delay; they are not reordered or replayed.

displayModeHint.message: Choose recommended settings for the content. Each scenario keeps its own Appearance and Behavior settings.

displayModeVideoHint.message: Keeps more of the video visible for games, tutorials, and videos.

displayModeChatHint.message: Shows enough messages across the full player for live chat and watch-alongs.

displayModeDefaultHint.message: Full-player danmaku by default. Busy moments may overlap and use more resources.

displayModeCustomHint.message: Custom settings. Select a mode to apply its recommended values.

maxDisplaysPerSecond.message: Comment Appearances per Second (0 means unlimited)

maxDisplaysHint.message: New comments over the limit are skipped, not delayed.

maxActiveDisplays.message: Comments Visible at Once (0 means unlimited)

maxActiveDisplaysHint.message: Only applies when overlap is allowed; new comments over the limit are skipped.

overflowMode.message: When There Is Not Enough Space

hideChatAfterLoad.message: Hide Chat in Fullscreen or Theater Mode

hideChatAfterLoadHint.message: Hide the chat panel while keeping it active for flow messages.

chatVisibilityControlHint.message: In fullscreen or theater mode, use the chat icon in the player controls to show or hide the chat panel.

supportDevelopmentHint.message: Help keep Danmaku Flow independently maintained.

toggleVisibility.message: Show or hide this comment type

chatVisibilityControlEducation.message: Use this button to show or hide the chat

releaseV017LivePages.message: Fixed chat hiding on YouTube /live pages, including chats that load later.

releaseV017HideChat.message: Hide the chat in fullscreen or theater mode while keeping danmaku active; it returns in normal view.

releaseV017Reliability.message: Improved chat visibility when navigating between videos or changing settings, and prevented repeated page resizing.
